scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

criticalPath: Separate deterministic index recovery from review-only Architecture inference, restore owned indexes, and present the first evidence-backed recovery finding.
